title: Seville Tapas  Bar Tour - A Question of Taste
text: After a recommendation, myself and my Daughter booked a Tapas bar tour with Roger.  He was a wonderful host, and took us to bars which we would have been unlikely to frequent.  His knowledge and passion were infectious, and he delivered a fantastic experience in Seville.  Great food, great wine and great company.  Thank you Roger, I would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone visiting this wonderful City.
author: M6671FBphilipr
